insights.insight: Crinkl has confirmed $4.89M in cryptographically verified GMV across ~102K receipts, with daily pace accelerating from ~$14K to ~$18K — putting the $5M milestone roughly 6 days out, half the timeline estimated 48 hours ago.

insights.topic: Grocery dominates but category mix is broadening
insights.insight: Over the past 14 days, grocery-supermarkets leads with 1,314 receipts and $56.9K GMV, but restaurants, department stores, gas/convenience, and shipping (The UPS Store in the top-5 brand list) collectively account for the majority of receipt flow — the signal set is not a single-category panel.

insights.topic: Walmart, Kroger, Costco, Publix now at threshold volume
insights.insight: The four largest U.S. grocery and mass-market retailers are all generating sustained receipt volume above the visibility floor, with Walmart at 298 receipts and Kroger at 139 over 14 days — enough to support brand-level purchase attribution against named retailers, not just category inference.

insights.topic: Trader Joe's and Sam's Club crossed the visibility threshold this week
insights.insight: Both brands crossed the suppressed-aggregate visibility floor on November 9, confirming sustained purchase activity — not just isolated transactions — which expands the addressable retailer footprint for brands running campaigns in premium grocery and warehouse club channels.

insights.topic: Dollar-anchored payout rate actively managed through BTC volatility
insights.insight: The policy rate has moved five times in eight days (124–134 sats/receipt) as BTC fluctuated between $74.7K and $80.4K, consistently holding the per-receipt dollar value near $0.10 — indicating the incentive layer is operationally stable for brands modeling consumer acquisition costs.

insights.topic: Geographic coverage remains early-stage with irregular pulse pattern
insights.insight: Only 19 CBSAs are visible in the public aggregate surface, with two new metro cells appearing since the prior snapshot — one of which (CBSA 11700) has pulsed in and out rather than holding, signaling that national coverage claims should be stress-tested against actual metro-level receipt density before campaign commitments.
